description:
Position: 
 Job Title: Java/J2EE Developer 
 Location: Orlando, FL 32826 
 Duration: 6 Months 
 
 Required Skills : J2EE, Weblogic, Adapters, Web Services, SOAP, UDDI, WSDL, XSD, XPath, Oracle 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 · Must have over 5+ years of experience in development, integration and implementation of SOA/J2EE Infrastructure. 
 · 3+ years of experience in application development using Oracle Fusion Middleware(J2EE, SOA Suite and web services).
 · 3+ years of experience in design and development of Oracle SOA/OSB solutions using Oracle SOA suite, OSB, and Web Services.
 · Expertise in using Adapters (File Adapter, FTP Adapter, Database Adapter, AQ Adapter, JMS Adapter) integrating with different systems using OSB.
 · Implementation Knowledge on Oracle SOA Suite 12c/11g, including creating composite, mediator, and Deployment on WebLogic Server.
 · Good knowledge of web-based standards such as SOAP, UDDI, WSDL, XSD, XPath, XSLT and XML. 
 · Excellent communication and team skills for smoothly accomplishing the technical job at hand.
 · Performs testing according to test plans and document test results & support users during user acceptance testing.
 · Must have a 4 year degree an in applicable STEM or related field.
 


 Desired Skills: 
 · Good understanding of Data warehouse and Operational Data Store concepts. 
 · Good understanding of Informatica/ODI/SSIS or related ETL tools. 
 · Experience in creating/maintaining deployments using ANT and WebLogic WLST. 
 · Experience in source control such as Perforce, TFS or GitHub 
 · Knowledge of API and proxy tools for web services such as Layer7 Secure Span Gateway. 
 · Experience with SaaS APIs such as Salesforce and Workday. 
 · Familiarity with development methodologies such as Agile, Waterfall and Systems Engineering,managers.

 To get further details or to apply, please contact:
